issues.description: Fixed an issue where content installation did not properly clean up temporary files, which led to persistent disk space consumption on the firewall. With this fix, content installation processes now correctly remove temporary files, preventing unnecessary disk space usage. As part of this fix, the following one time setting is recommended to ensure disk usage doesn't reach 100% - configure aggressive disk cleaning, delete old content cache, and set the maximum number of images. For example, use the commands: debug software disk-usage aggressive-cleaning enable, delete content cache old-content, and set max-num-images count 2.
